subject: Proposed Food Truck Ordinance
overview: The committee discussed a draft ordinance to establish an administrative permitting process for stationary food trucks at one-day and special events. The body amended the draft to streamline departmental reviews and kept the matter in committee for further refinement.

items.title: Draft Food Truck Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed a draft ordinance (Paper 20-020) intended to create an administrative licensing process for one-day and special event food trucks.

items.title: Discussion of Legal Review and Economic Impact
items.summary: Councilors discussed the fiscal impact of using outside legal counsel for ordinance reviews and the potential competition food trucks pose to brick-and-mortar businesses.

items.title: Amendment to Departmental Coordination
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the draft ordinance to replace formal departmental reports and CORI check requirements with an internal coordination process led by the Board of Health.

items.title: Matter Kept in Committee
items.summary: Tabled the ordinance in committee pending further technical feedback from the Board of Health and the Chamber of Commerce.
